description: Integration test to verify signal_analyser_v2.py correctly writes rows to mcp_signal_scores table with the required evidence blob shape: {"signal_type": "<snake_case>", "confidence": 0.0-1.0, "evidence_blob": {...}}. Must query the table and assert at least one row exists with valid evidence_blob from each of the 8 signal types. Tests the wiring between analyser output and the composite scoring pipeline. Exit 0 on success.
